editorial.blurb: This West Loop newcomer serves creative Chinese noodles and bold flavors in a vibrant, welcoming space that punches well above its casual price point.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit happy hour for stellar value on their cocktails and soju selection, and don't skip the garlic edamame—it arrives dripping in an incredible sauce that regulars rave about.
signatureDishes: Signature Noodle Soup with Braised Wagyu Brisket
